name: Steadfast Love
overview: Scripture reveals steadfast love as the faithful and enduring mercy of God toward those who love Him and keep His commandments, demonstrated by His covenant faithfulness to a thousand generations (Deuteronomy 7:9). This steadfast love is characterized by compassion, grace, longsuffering, and truth, as seen in the heartfelt pleas for mercy and forgiveness (Psalms 51:1; 86:15). The psalmists call all nations to praise and give thanks to the LORD for His goodness and eternal mercy, highlighting that His lovingkindness endures forever (Psalms 117:1; 118:1; 136:26).
